verdict.rationale: Circle documents concrete fiat-settlement paths: Circle Mint lets qualified businesses convert USD to/from USDC at no cost, and Circle Payments Network offers a 'Managed' option where Circle handles custody, compliance, treasury and settlement, plus cross-border payout partners that receive USDC and deliver local fiat. This directly supports a finance lead's need to accept stablecoins but keep books in fiat. Missing for 10: no explicit end-to-end 'auto-convert every incoming payment to fiat/bank payout' workflow or accounting-ledger integration is documented, and no independent/hands-on case study confirms this works smoothly at scale.
